description: Source code defining models for payment types, modes, orders, and lines in an OpenERP/Odoo module related to account payments.

classes.name: payment_type
classes.description: Model representing different types of payments, including their name, code, and suitable bank types.

classes.name: payment_mode
classes.description: Model representing payment modes, including bank account, journal, and associated payment type.

classes.name: payment_order
classes.description: Model representing a payment order, including its state, total, and related payment lines.

classes.name: payment_line
classes.description: Model representing individual payment lines, including references to move lines, amounts, and associated partner info.

methods.name: suitable_bank_types
methods.description: Returns bank type codes suitable for a given payment type code.

methods.name: get_wizard
methods.description: Logs a warning if no wizard is found for a given payment type.

methods.name: _total
methods.description: Calculates total amount for a payment order based on its lines.

methods.name: set_to_draft
methods.description: Resets a payment order to draft state and triggers workflow.

methods.name: action_open
methods.description: Sets a payment order to open state, generating a reference if missing.

methods.name: set_done
methods.description: Marks a payment order as done, setting the completion date and triggering workflow.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Translates certain field names to internal representations.

methods.name: info_owner
methods.description: Retrieves address info of the owner (bank partner).

methods.name: info_partner
methods.description: Retrieves address info of the partner.

methods.name: select_by_name
methods.description: Fetches move line info and partner name based on a specified field.

methods.name: _amount
methods.description: Computes amount in company currency for a payment line.

methods.name: _value_date
methods.description: Determines the value date for a payment line based on order preferences.

methods.name: _get_currency
methods.description: Retrieves the currency ID for the current user or defaults to rate 1.0.

methods.name: _get_ml_inv_ref
methods.description: Gets invoice reference related to a move line.

methods.name: _get_ml_maturity_date
methods.description: Gets maturity date from move line.

methods.name: _get_ml_created_date
methods.description: Gets creation date from move line.

methods.name: onchange_move_line
methods.description: Updates payment line data based on selected move line.

methods.name: onchange_amount
methods.description: Recalculates amount in company currency based on partner currency amount.

methods.name: onchange_partner
methods.description: Updates partner info and bank selection based on partner ID.

methods.name: fields_get
methods.description: Overrides fields_get to set readonly states for communication2 field.
